finding: The initial regression repeated in BAAB order and pinned ABBA runs. Disassembly showed identical scalar validator instructions shifted from function address 0x142010 to 0x1422b0; the ASCII loop crossed a 64-byte instruction boundary in the initial candidate. Requesting GNU x86 function alignment moved it to 0x1422c0 and removed the measured slowdown. This is scoped compiler/host evidence, not a universal cache-performance claim.
